payload.posture: Read John 14:18–20 as one movement in the resurrection, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states jesus says he will not leave the disciples orphaned, contrasts the world’s coming inability to see him with the disciples’ sight, and connects his life with theirs. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the resurrection.
